instruction: Always stay inside the arena.
rationale: All steps in bounds.

instruction: Remain within arena bounds throughout the episode.
rationale: All steps in bounds.

instruction: Never get tagged.
rationale: Absorbing safety requirement.

instruction: At no point may a controlled boat be tagged.
rationale: Absorbing safety requirement.

instruction: Eventually capture the enemy flag.
rationale: No additional no-tag clause.

instruction: Score at least once before the episode ends.
rationale: No additional no-tag clause.

instruction: Eventually reach the home flag stand.
rationale: Home means flag vicinity, not own half.

instruction: At some time reach within catch radius of our flag home.
rationale: Home means flag vicinity, not own half.

instruction: Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
rationale: Inclusive sequencing as specified by benchmark context.

instruction: Obtain the opposing flag, then eventually score.
rationale: Inclusive sequencing as specified by benchmark context.

instruction: Carry the flag and capture it strictly later.
rationale: Strong next distinguishes strict from inclusive order.

instruction: At some point possess the flag; score at a later step, not that same step.
rationale: Strong next distinguishes strict from inclusive order.

instruction: Reach home and then eventually capture.
rationale: Reverse witness must not suffice.

instruction: Visit our flag home, followed by a score.
rationale: Reverse witness must not suffice.

instruction: Whenever carrying the flag, eventually reach our flag stand.
rationale: Response includes same step and applies at every time.

instruction: Every possession of the flag must be followed by reaching home.
rationale: Response includes same step and applies at every time.

instruction: Whenever we have the flag, eventually score.
rationale: Vacuously true if no possession; no invented eventual possession.

instruction: Each time a boat carries the flag, the team must eventually capture.
rationale: Vacuously true if no possession; no invented eventual possession.

instruction: Whenever an attacker is forward, no teammate may be tagged.
rationale: Direction of implication matters.

instruction: If an attacker is beyond midfield, the team must be untagged at that step.
rationale: Direction of implication matters.

instruction: Keep designated defender agent 0 behind the centerline at all times.
rationale: Designated role only, not existential quantification.

instruction: Agent zero must always remain in our half.
rationale: Designated role only, not existential quantification.

instruction: While an attacker is forward, agent 0 must remain behind midfield.
rationale: Do not replace this with a global defender obligation.

instruction: If any attacker crosses into enemy territory, keep the designated defender in our half.
rationale: Do not replace this with a global defender obligation.

instruction: Stay in bounds and eventually capture without getting tagged.
rationale: Three independent clauses.

instruction: Always remain inside, never be tagged, and score before the deadline.
rationale: Three independent clauses.

instruction: Always stay in bounds. Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
rationale: Safety plus ordered task.

instruction: Remain inside the arena while completing possession followed by capture.
rationale: Safety plus ordered task.

instruction: Stay untagged until capturing, and do capture.
rationale: Strong until, not weak until and not global no-tag.

instruction: Avoid tags until the first score; scoring must eventually happen.
rationale: Strong until, not weak until and not global no-tag.

instruction: On the next step, be inside the arena.
rationale: Strong next rejects a one-state trace.

instruction: The immediately following state must be in bounds.
rationale: Strong next rejects a one-state trace.

instruction: If you have the flag, return to your side.
rationale: Own-half predicate is absent; home would silently strengthen the instruction.

instruction: When carrying it, go back to our half.
rationale: Own-half predicate is absent; home would silently strengthen the instruction.

instruction: Keep one defender behind the centerline.
rationale: Existential role cannot be replaced with designated agent 0.

instruction: At least one team member should stay back to defend.
rationale: Existential role cannot be replaced with designated agent 0.

instruction: If an opponent approaches, retreat toward home.
rationale: Approach/close and retreat direction have no grounded AP.

instruction: Fall back when the enemy gets close.
rationale: Approach/close and retreat direction have no grounded AP.

instruction: One attacker should capture while another supports.
rationale: Support and per-agent task quantification are not grounded.

instruction: Have one teammate score as a second teammate provides support.
rationale: Support and per-agent task quantification are not grounded.

instruction: Whenever our team has a flag carrier, every controlled boat must be inside the arena.
rationale: Team possession implies all-team bounds; no eventual-capture obligation.

instruction: At each step with enemy-flag possession, require all of our boats to be in bounds.
rationale: Team possession implies all-team bounds; no eventual-capture obligation.

instruction: Whenever any designated attacker is beyond midfield, keep every controlled boat inside the arena.
rationale: Conditional bounds only while an attacker is forward.

instruction: If an attacker is forward at a step, all of our boats must be in bounds at that step.
rationale: Conditional bounds only while an attacker is forward.

instruction: Whenever agent zero is behind midfield, no controlled teammate may be tagged.
rationale: This does not require agent zero to remain behind midfield.

instruction: Require the whole team to be untagged at every step when the designated defender is in our half.
rationale: This does not require agent zero to remain behind midfield.

instruction: Whenever at least one controlled boat is outside the arena, at least one controlled boat must be tagged.
rationale: Aggregate consequence of auto-tagging, not a per-boat identity assertion.

instruction: At every step where our team is not wholly in bounds, require a tagged boat on our team.
rationale: Aggregate consequence of auto-tagging, not a per-boat identity assertion.

instruction: At some step, our team must have the enemy flag while a controlled boat is near our own flag stand.
rationale: The carrier and home boat may be the same boat; distinct identities are not asserted.

instruction: Eventually require both team flag possession and a controlled boat within the home-flag catch radius at the same step.
rationale: The carrier and home boat may be the same boat; distinct identities are not asserted.

instruction: Eventually have agent zero behind midfield and a designated attacker beyond midfield at the same step.
rationale: An eventual joint role configuration, not a global role constraint.

instruction: At least once, our defender must be in our half while an attacker is forward.
rationale: An eventual joint role configuration, not a global role constraint.

instruction: Eventually either score a capture or have a controlled boat near our flag stand; both are also acceptable.
rationale: Inclusive alternative, not a requirement to achieve both.

instruction: Before the episode ends, satisfy at least one of team capture and home-flag proximity.
rationale: Inclusive alternative, not a requirement to achieve both.

instruction: At some step a controlled boat must be near our flag stand while every teammate is untagged.
rationale: Joint eventual condition; no never-tagged contract.

instruction: Eventually combine home-flag proximity with a completely untagged controlled team.
rationale: Joint eventual condition; no never-tagged contract.

instruction: First the team must hold the enemy flag, then some controlled boat must reach our flag stand, then the team must score.
rationale: Inclusive sequence over team predicates, not a carrier-specific return assertion.

instruction: Require team possession followed by home-flag proximity followed by a capture; these milestones may share a step.
rationale: Inclusive sequence over team predicates, not a carrier-specific return assertion.

instruction: Have an attacker beyond midfield, then obtain team flag possession, then capture; milestones may share a step.
rationale: Three ordered team milestones with inclusive eventually.

instruction: Eventually progress from an attacker being forward to holding the enemy flag and then scoring.
rationale: Three ordered team milestones with inclusive eventually.

instruction: Have a boat near our flag stand, possess the enemy flag at a strictly later step, and score strictly after that.
rationale: Strong next enforces both strict ordering boundaries.

instruction: Require home-flag proximity, then later possession, then a still later capture; neither transition may be simultaneous.
rationale: Strong next enforces both strict ordering boundaries.

instruction: At some step put agent zero behind midfield, and at a strictly later step have an attacker beyond midfield.
rationale: Strict eventual role sequence without persistent defender requirement.

instruction: Establish the designated defender in our half before a later forward-attacker milestone; different steps are required.
rationale: Strict eventual role sequence without persistent defender requirement.

instruction: Whenever any controlled boat is tagged, require some controlled boat to eventually be near our flag stand.
rationale: Deliberately aggregate recovery abstraction; it does not express identity-preserving recovery.

instruction: Each team-tagged state must be followed now or later by team home-flag proximity; it need not be the tagged boat.
rationale: Deliberately aggregate recovery abstraction; it does not express identity-preserving recovery.

instruction: Whenever any controlled boat is tagged, the whole controlled team must become untagged at a strictly later step.
rationale: Strong-next response; tag at final step cannot satisfy this obligation.

instruction: After each tagged-team state, require a later step with no tagged controlled teammates.
rationale: Strong-next response; tag at final step cannot satisfy this obligation.

instruction: Whenever an attacker is forward, require some controlled boat to reach home-flag proximity now or later.
rationale: The responding boat identity is intentionally unspecified.

instruction: Every forward-attacker state must have an eventual team home-proximity response, not necessarily by that attacker.
rationale: The responding boat identity is intentionally unspecified.

instruction: Whenever agent zero is behind midfield, the team must score at that step or a later one.
rationale: A response condition; no unconditional defender or capture existence is added.

instruction: Each designated-defender-behind state must be followed by an eventual team capture.
rationale: A response condition; no unconditional defender or capture existence is added.

instruction: Whenever the team possesses the enemy flag, require home-flag proximity at a strictly later step.
rationale: Strict response over aggregate predicates.

instruction: Every possession state must be followed later, not simultaneously, by some controlled boat near our flag stand.
rationale: Strict response over aggregate predicates.

instruction: Whenever the team is not completely untagged, agent zero must eventually be behind midfield.
rationale: Uses teammate_safe from the glossary, not distance-based safety.

instruction: If at least one teammate is tagged, require the designated defender behind center now or later.
rationale: Uses teammate_safe from the glossary, not distance-based safety.

instruction: While an attacker is forward and the team has no enemy flag, keep agent zero behind midfield.
rationale: Two antecedent conditions, not a globally fixed defender.

instruction: Require our designated defender in our half whenever an attacker is forward without team flag possession.
rationale: Two antecedent conditions, not a globally fixed defender.

instruction: Whenever the team has a tagged boat or is not entirely in bounds, eventually have some controlled boat near our flag stand.
rationale: Inclusive disjunction of aggregate triggers.

instruction: A tag or any boundary exit must trigger eventual team home-flag proximity; either trigger is sufficient.
rationale: Inclusive disjunction of aggregate triggers.

instruction: Whenever the team has the flag and an attacker is forward, eventually score.
rationale: Conditional capture; neither antecedent is required to occur.

instruction: Require a current or later capture after each step with both team possession and a forward attacker.
rationale: Conditional capture; neither antecedent is required to occur.

instruction: If the team is not completely untagged while an attacker is forward, agent zero must be behind midfield on the next step.
rationale: Strong-next obligation, not an eventual response.

instruction: Following a step with a tagged teammate and a forward attacker, require the designated defender behind center immediately next.
rationale: Strong-next obligation, not an eventual response.

instruction: Keep every controlled boat inside the arena and eventually have a boat near our flag stand.
rationale: Persistent bounds plus independent eventual home condition.

instruction: Always stay in bounds as a team, and reach team home-flag proximity before the episode ends.
rationale: Persistent bounds plus independent eventual home condition.

instruction: Never allow a controlled boat to be tagged, and visit our flag stand before an eventual capture.
rationale: Global no-tag constraint plus ordered mission; no global bounds clause.

instruction: Keep the team untagged throughout while achieving home-flag proximity followed by scoring; simultaneous milestones are allowed.
rationale: Global no-tag constraint plus ordered mission; no global bounds clause.

instruction: Keep agent zero behind midfield throughout; eventually have an attacker forward and then score.
rationale: Fixed defender with an inclusive offensive sequence.

instruction: Maintain our designated defender in our half for the whole episode, with a forward-attacker milestone followed by a team capture.
rationale: Fixed defender with an inclusive offensive sequence.

instruction: Keep all boats in bounds, require every teammate untagged whenever an attacker is forward, and eventually possess the enemy flag.
rationale: Three clauses; pickup rather than capture is the eventual objective.

instruction: Always stay inside; while an attacker is forward keep the controlled team untagged; obtain team flag possession at least once.
rationale: Three clauses; pickup rather than capture is the eventual objective.

instruction: Eventually have a boat near our flag stand and eventually score, in either order.
rationale: Two independent eventualities, not an ordered sequence.

instruction: Achieve both home-flag proximity and a capture sometime during the episode; no order is required.
rationale: Two independent eventualities, not an ordered sequence.

instruction: Obtain the enemy flag at least once, and ensure every possession state has a capture at that step or later.
rationale: Existence plus universal response; later possession after a score still creates an obligation.

instruction: Require some team possession plus a current-or-future scoring response to each possession state, not just the first.
rationale: Existence plus universal response; later possession after a score still creates an obligation.

instruction: Keep the team untagged until some controlled boat is near our flag stand, and require that home milestone to occur.
rationale: Strong until; tagging at the home step itself is not prohibited by this formula.

instruction: Home-flag proximity must happen; before its first satisfying step no controlled boat may be tagged.
rationale: Strong until; tagging at the home step itself is not prohibited by this formula.

instruction: Always keep the team in bounds and avoid all tags until the team obtains the enemy flag; obtaining it is required.
rationale: Strong until acquisition plus global bounds, without a capture requirement.

instruction: Remain inside throughout and require possession, with no team tag at steps before the possession milestone.
rationale: Strong until acquisition plus global bounds, without a capture requirement.

instruction: At some step have a controlled boat near our flag stand, and from that step through the end keep every boat inside the arena.
rationale: Bounds are required only from the selected home milestone onward.

instruction: Eventually establish home-flag proximity together with bounds compliance that lasts for the rest of the episode.
rationale: Bounds are required only from the selected home milestone onward.

instruction: At some step the team must possess the flag and remain completely untagged from that step through the end.
rationale: Eventual persistent no-tag suffix; earlier tags are permitted.

instruction: Eventually obtain a possession state after which no controlled boat is tagged, including at that selected state.
rationale: Eventual persistent no-tag suffix; earlier tags are permitted.

instruction: When an opponent gets within twelve meters of our carrier, have that carrier evade.
rationale: Requires distance, carrier identity, and an evasion-action predicate absent from this profile.

instruction: Make the flag carrier dodge whenever an enemy is closer than twelve meters.
rationale: Requires distance, carrier identity, and an evasion-action predicate absent from this profile.

instruction: Maintain at least four meters of separation from every other boat.
rationale: No distance or collision predicate is available; tagged is not collision proximity.

instruction: Never come within the competition collision distance of a teammate or opponent.
rationale: No distance or collision predicate is available; tagged is not collision proximity.

instruction: During our Powerplay, keep the disabled opponent from moving or tagging.
rationale: Requires Powerplay timing, disabled-agent identity, and action predicates.

instruction: For the Powerplay interval, prevent the selected red boat from moving and interacting with flags.
rationale: Requires Powerplay timing, disabled-agent identity, and action predicates.

instruction: Tag an opponent only when both of those boats are in our territory.
rationale: Our tagged atom describes controlled boats being tagged, not tagging actions or per-boat territory.

instruction: Permit a tagging action only if the tagging boat and its target are both on our side.
rationale: Our tagged atom describes controlled boats being tagged, not tagging actions or per-boat territory.

instruction: Return the flag carrier to either official corner home base to score.
rationale: home denotes the flag stand vicinity, not official corner bases; no per-carrier corner predicate exists.

instruction: Complete a capture by bringing the carrier into one of the competition corner capture zones.
rationale: home denotes the flag stand vicinity, not official corner bases; no per-carrier corner predicate exists.

instruction: Defend whenever necessary, otherwise attack.
rationale: The defense trigger and role-switch criteria are unspecified.

instruction: Switch to defense when the situation calls for it; attack at other times.
rationale: The defense trigger and role-switch criteria are unspecified.

instruction: Capture quickly but do not take too much risk.
rationale: No deadline, risk measure, or acceptable threshold is provided.

instruction: Score soon while keeping risk at an acceptable level.
rationale: No deadline, risk measure, or acceptable threshold is provided.

instruction: Have one attacker carry the flag while a different attacker escorts it.
rationale: Requires distinct-boat identity and support/escort predicates; aggregate possession cannot express it.

instruction: Assign separate boats to carrying the flag and supporting the carrier.
rationale: Requires distinct-boat identity and support/escort predicates; aggregate possession cannot express it.
